tables.name: Events
tables.description: Extra Intrigue. Rites of passage and celebrations currently taking place, imminent, or coming to a close.

results.name: Birth or Birthday
results.description: Blessings are sought for individuals on the day of their birth.

results.name: Party
results.description: These are fun events that bring the community together for fellowship and camaraderie, and could be happening for a number of reasons.

results.name: Funeral
results.description: A gathering to remember those from the community who passed away, either in mourning or in celebration of their life, with a party reflecting the things that meant most to the deceased.

results.name: Harvest and Productivity
results.description: Villagers seek blessings for upcoming work, such as a harvest, or thanks are given for bountiful yields.

results.name: Love
results.description: Festivities to encourage pairing, celebrating couples and family.

results.name: Political
results.description: A celebration honoring events of national significance, such as remembering a great victory, or gaining independence.

results.name: Religious
results.description: Events relating to and honoring a venerated deity are often regular and steeped in tradition.

results.name: Wedding
results.description: Celebrating the formal joining of two families.

results.name: Local
results.description: Celebration revolving around a major local event or the deeds of a local hero.

results.name: Travel & Welcome
results.description: Festivities welcome someone new to the community, or someone well on a journey.
